csv_project_name: Design for Drayton Plains Downtown Revitalization Project
csv_scope_of_work: The Charter Township of Waterford ("Township") has been awarded Community Project Funding (CPF) through the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) for the implementation of public infrastructure improvements within the Drayton Plains Downtown District. The Township is seeking proposals from qualified consulting firms ("Consultant") to provide professional planning, landscape architecture, surveying, engineering, permitting, and bidding assistance services necessary to prepare design and construction documents for the Drayton Plains Downtown Revitalization Project.
